verdict.rationale: The agency's own pages say business-license applications can be submitted online, and that B&O tax must be reported and paid through My DOR, its online filing tool. The help pages walk through the online return step by step, including ACH payment and a printable confirmation. The probe's login wall matches an authenticated portal and does not contradict these claims. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of completing a transaction end-to-end, since the portal sits behind authentication and was not exercised.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Apply online applications will take approximately 10 business days to process.
You must report and pay B&O tax on the Excise Tax Return using MyDOR, the department's online filing tool.
Bank Account (ACH Debit) will deduct the payment from the bank account you select on the next page.
You can print the Confirmation page by clicking Print Confirmation.
Express file online. No login required.
